entities.name: Flight of the Ornithopter
entities.description: Event at Tocasia's Digsite in which Urza and Mishra test-flew a restored ornithopter, leading to the discovery of Koilos.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra who won the coin flip and flew the ornithopter first.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's passionate brother who flew the ornithopter and spotted a pattern in the desert.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Archaeologist who led the dig and intervened on Mishra's behalf.

entities.name: Tocasia's Digsite
entities.description: Dig site in the desert where the event happened.

entities.name: Reconstructed Thopter
entities.description: The repaired ornithopter fitted with a powerstone.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: Region to which the desert symbols pointed.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Location whose discovery the event eventually led to.

events.summary: Urza, Mishra and Tocasia repair a broken ornithopter and fit it with a powerstone.
events.quote: they spent some time fixing it and fitting it with a powerstone

events.summary: Urza wins a coin flip and flies the craft over the dig site.
events.quote: Urza won and launched the craft

events.summary: Urza refuses to let Mishra fly; Tocasia intervenes on Mishra's behalf.
events.quote: only Tocasia's intervention on Mishra's behalf calmed things down

events.summary: Mishra flies off across the dunes, returns to an enraged Urza and explains he saw a pattern marking other dig sites.
events.quote: he had seen a pattern in the desert

relations.quote: Urza and Mishra couldn't agree on who was to fly the craft

relations.note: Tocasia took Mishra's side and calmed the brothers.
